import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

accessions = {'SULT1A1':'P50225','SULT1A2':'P50226','SULT1A3':'P0DMM9',
 'SULT1B1':'O43704','SULT1C2':'O00338','SULT1C4':'O75897','SULT1E1':'P49888'}
seqs={n:''.join(l.strip() for l in requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.splitlines() if not l.startswith('>')) for n,a in accessions.items()}
# reuse alignment mapping (compact NW)
aas="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVBZX*"
bl="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0 -2 -1 0 -4

S={(a,b):int(bl[i].split()[j]) for i,a in enumerate(aas) for j,b in enumerate(aas)}
def sc(a,b): return S.get((a,b),-1)
def nw(s1,s2,gap=-10):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    for i in range(1,n+1):F[i][0]=gap*i;P[i][0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1):F[0][j]=gap*j;P[0][j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=F[i-1][j-1]+sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1]);u=F[i-1][j]+gap;l=F[i][j-1]+gap
            b=max(d,u,l);F[i][j]=b;P[i][j]=0 if b==d else(1 if b==u else 2)
    i,j=n,m;a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i][j]
        if i>0 and j>0 and p==0:a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif i>0 and(j==0 or p==1):a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1
        else:a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return a1[::-1],a2[::-1]

ref=seqs['SULT1A1']
# exclude backbone/PAPS-facing catalytic anchors (106,108) to focus on ACCEPTOR-lining residues
pocket_nums=[21,24,47,76,77,81,84,89,90,142,146,148,149,240,243,247,248,255]
order=['SULT1A1','SULT1A2','SULT1A3','SULT1E1','SULT1B1','SULT1C2','SULT1C4']
tab={'SULT1A1':[ref[p-1] for p in pocket_nums]}
for name in order:
    if name=='SULT1A1':continue
    a1,a2=nw(ref,seqs[name]);rp=0;mp={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-':rp+=1;mp[rp]=c2
    tab[name]=[mp.get(p,'-') for p in pocket_nums]

# physicochemical scales
kd={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,
'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2,'-':0}
charge={'D':-1,'E':-1,'K':1,'R':1,'H':0.1}
arom=set('FYW')
rows=[]
for n in order:
    res=tab[n]
    hyd=np.mean([kd.get(r,0) for r in res])
    net=sum(charge.get(r,0) for r in res)
    acid=sum(1 for r in res if r in 'DE')
    naром=sum(1 for r in res if r in arom)
    rows.append((n,round(hyd,2),round(net,1),acid,naром))
props=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['isoform','mean_KD_hydropathy','net_charge','n_acidic(D/E)','n_aromatic(F/Y/W)'])
print("Acceptor-lining pocket physicochemistry (18 residues, catalytic K106/H108 excluded):")
print(props.to_string(index=False))

# plot
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
c=['#c62828' if x=='SULT1A1' else ('#ef9a9a' if x=='SULT1A2' else '#1565c0') for x in props.isoform]
axs[0].bar(props.isoform,props['n_acidic(D/E)'],color=c);axs[0].set_ylabel('# acidic residues (D/E) in pocket')
axs[0].set_title('Acidic residues in acceptor pocket');axs[0].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=45)
axs[1].bar(props.isoform,props['mean_KD_hydropathy'],color=c);axs[1].set_ylabel('mean Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy')
axs[1].set_title('Pocket hydrophobicity');axs[1].tick_params(axis='x',rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('sult_pocket_physicochem.png',dpi=140)
print("\nFigure saved: sult_pocket_physicochem.png")
print("\nNote: SULT1A1 & SULT1A2 pockets have 0 acidic residues; SULT1A3 introduces 2 (E89,E146).")
